evidence: 0111 (one-person lab check), owner decision 33.3: "two-person lab check default; a single-person facility may release with a typed, logged reason", and the owner decision of 3 Nov 2026 13:00 to switch One-person lab ON at Demo Laboratory only, inside 0111; unsigned until the owner signs. Written on 0103 (34d6955). The numbers 0104-0110 belong to other unreleased work and are not on this branch; 0111 reads and needs nothing they add (its preconditions pin only 0001-0103 objects), so they may be applied before it, but if one of them replaces a body 0111 pins (listed under PRECONDITIONS) 0111 stops with 55000 and nothing applied, and the ledger entries (components.json, verify-migration-ledger.mjs, the temporary 0104-0110 allowance in verify-release-contract.mjs) must be re-based when they land first. The declaration lists 0111 and runtime-grants.sql only, on the assumption that production has applied 0102 and 0103 (signed 2026-11-02) and none of 0104-0110 is released with it; otherwise it must be widened, or the release stops with EXACT_SCHEMA_CHANGE_DECLARATION_REQUIRED. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE. Additive only: two new tables (identity.facility_lab_check_settings, append-only, and identity.facility_lab_check_current), two columns on lab.result_verifications (self_check boolean not null default false, added as metadata only; one_person_setting_id uuid null) with a foreign key to the setting row and the check result_verifications_self_check_ck that every existing row (false/null) passes, four new SECURITY DEFINER functions, and a new body of lab.validate_result_governance() (signature, language, volatility, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path, owner, ACL and its three triggers unchanged). No existing row is touched; no RLS, FORCE or policy change on any existing table (post-checked). On Amazon RDS only it also inserts one setting row, one current row and one audit row for Demo Laboratory (below). Today's images give the same answers on 0111, except that a same-person check, refused before, is now refused with a coded 23514 message (LAB_RESULT_SECOND_CHECK_REQUIRED; still 500 in today's Lab API), and at Demo Laboratory an explicit self-check, which today's Lab API cannot send, would be accepted. The new Lab API needs 0111 first (its Lab-staff result and execution reads, and execution start and complete, call lab.one_person_lab_enabled() once per request; released-only reads do not). WHAT IT DOES. A facility administrator (organization.manage at the session facility; admin and org_admin, not org_admin_awaiting_review nor lab) switches One-person lab with identity.set_facility_one_person_lab(enabled, reason): the reason trimmed of every whitespace character JavaScript's trim removes (spaces, tabs, line breaks, form feeds, no-break and other Unicode spaces, U+FEFF) must be 10-500 characters, else 22023 FACILITY_SETTING_REASON_INVALID (a reason of only tabs or line breaks is refused by the database itself, and by the setting table's and result_verifications_self_check_ck's checks); the same value again is P0001 FACILITY_SETTING_UNCHANGED with nothing written; any other actor, no correlation id or another purpose is 42501 FACILITY_SETTING_PERMISSION_DENIED. Each switch writes one setting row and one audit.events row (actor_type staff, identity.facility.one-person-lab.on/.off, resource facility, the typed reason, details settingId, onePersonLab, previous; ids and booleans only). identity.facility_one_person_lab_state() reads it for the same actor; lab.one_person_lab_enabled() answers the caller's own facility's switch and false without an active membership there. In the governance trigger an invalidated version keeps its old message; a same-person check is refused (LAB_RESULT_SECOND_CHECK_REQUIRED when off; LAB_RESULT_SELF_CHECK_REASON_REQUIRED when on but self_check not asked; 22023 LAB_RESULT_SELF_CHECK_REASON_INVALID when the trimmed reason is not 10-500) unless it is an explicit self-check in a One-person lab, which records self_check and the newest setting id (never the client's); a different person asking self_check is LAB_RESULT_SELF_CHECK_NOT_YOURS; release and invalidation are byte for byte 0077's. The trigger holds the facility's current setting row FOR SHARE and the setter updates it: a switch-off waits for an open self-check, and a SERIALIZABLE self-check whose snapshot predates a committed switch-off fails 40001 (the Lab API retries and then sees off). THE SEALED DEMO. identity.demo_one_person_lab_install() (owner-only, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path pg_catalog, pg_temp, granted to no role) runs at the end of 0111 only where the role rds_superuser exists (production, as 0098 D3 and 0102 D1). It refuses 55000 0111: SEALED_DEMO_LAB_CHECK_NOT_DEMO, nothing applied, unless Demo Laboratory (98d00002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002, code DEMO-LABORATORY, organization 98d00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000002), the demo staff account 98d00003-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 and its lab membership there 98d00005-0000-4000-8000-000000000002 are the sealed demo's as 0098 left them (identity.sealed_demo_members). It then writes, once, the setting row 98d0000b-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 (one_person true, reason 'Demo Laboratory works as a one-person lab for the demo (owner decision, 3 Nov 2026).', set_by the demo login's Demo Laboratory membership, correlation id 0111-sealed-demo-one-person-lab), its current row and one audit row (actor_type system, no actor subject, account or membership, no patient, provenance migration, source_system hid-sealed-demo, action identity.facility.one-person-lab.on, resource the facility, details settingId, onePersonLab true, previous false); when Demo Laboratory already has a setting it writes nothing. It adds no demo member and changes no seal trigger or policy. Every other facility, Demo Hospital, Demo Pharmacy and Demo Outreach among them, stays off. Before signing, the owner may run on production, as the owner of schema identity, the install's own refusal test (the same text is in 0111's header 7, and lab-one-person-demo runs it: false without the demo, true after 0098's install, false with another Demo Laboratory code); it must answer true, else 0111 stops with SEALED_DEMO_LAB_CHECK_NOT_DEMO and holds back the release: select identity.sealed_demo_facility('98d00002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002') and identity.sealed_demo_account('98d00003-0000-4000-8000-000000000001') and exists (select 1 from identity.sealed_demo_members m where m.member_kind = 'organization' and m.member_id = '98d00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000002') and exists (select 1 from identity.facilities f where f.id = '98d00002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' and f.organization_id = '98d00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' and upper(f.code) = 'DEMO-LABORATORY') and exists (select 1 from identity.staff_facility_memberships s where s.id = '98d00005-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' and s.account_id = '98d00003-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' and s.facility_id = '98d00002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' and s.organization_id = '98d00001-0000-4000-8000-000000000002') as demo_laboratory_ready. runtime-grants.sql gains a 0111 block: the two tables revoked from PUBLIC and granted to no role; EXECUTE on the two identity functions to hid_identity_runtime and on lab.one_person_lab_enabled() to hid_lab_runtime; identity.demo_one_person_lab_install() revoked from PUBLIC; the migration makes the same grants. PRECONDITIONS (catalog reads only, 55000 or 42501, nothing applied): the applier is the owner of schema identity or an inheriting member that may SET ROLE to it (checked first); 0001-0103 applied (0103's identity.organization_application_admin_account md5 186eb4ca420749b8bdb324bdc843bc50; identity.sealed_demo_members present); not applied yet (neither table, no self_check column, no demo install function); md5 of lab.validate_result_governance() 6bf52a22ce45e834d4f2a194a06babad and of the platform.current_* readers, auth.account_id_for_subject, identity.has_active_membership, auth.membership_has_permission, platform.reject_mutation, identity.sealed_demo_facility (d91d91c1d3e1a455e49c5960f313a6e7) and identity.sealed_demo_account (16eae1d6c33b3bef793796cf66f1cdf6); the governance function's attributes and its three enabled triggers; organization.manage active and not held by lab; the columns and constraints of lab.result_verifications as 0021 left them; one owner for the function, the tables read or referenced and schemas identity and lab. LOCKS (measured on the 0110-numbered draft, unchanged in this file's DDL): ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on lab.result_verifications; SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on identity.facilities, identity.staff_facility_memberships and auth.accounts (the new foreign keys); ACCESS SHARE on auth.permissions, auth.role_permissions, the replaced pg_proc row, the schemas and the language; on RDS the demo seed adds ROW EXCLUSIVE on the two new tables and audit.events. Behind an open transaction holding ROW EXCLUSIVE on lab.result_verifications the runner stopped after its 5 s lock_timeout with nothing applied. PROOF on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 cluster (private socket and port, deleted after), this file as committed: upgrade of a 0103 database (0001-0103 by the runner as a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator, the 34d6955 runtime-grants.sql, then the runner: plan 1 pending, dry run rolled back, apply, 0 pending; the file again by hand answers 0111: already applied; then a bootstrap with this runtime-grants.sql, verified); fresh install 0001-0111 (105 files) and bootstrap, verified; all 79 database suites pass on both (77 as the superuser, schema and ocr-worker-lease as the database owner, as they also need on 0103), lab-one-person-check and the new lab-one-person-demo among them; an inheriting member applied it (new objects owned by the owner), a stranger was refused 42501 with nothing applied. RDS path: with a role rds_superuser created, on a 0103 copy after 0098's identity.sealed_demo_install(), the runner applied 0111 and wrote {"settings": 1}: ON at DEMO-LABORATORY, off at DEMO-HOSPITAL, DEMO-PHARMACY and DEMO-OUTREACH, and lab-one-person-check passed there; on a 0103 copy without the demo the runner stopped with 0111: SEALED_DEMO_LAB_CHECK_NOT_DEMO and 1 pending, nothing applied. lab-one-person-demo proves: the install refused without the demo and with a changed Demo Laboratory code (nothing written); the setting, current and audit rows as above; a second call writes nothing; ON at Demo Laboratory and off at every other facility in the tables, through lab.one_person_lab_enabled() as the demo login at all four demo facilities, through the administrator's read, and through the governance trigger (the demo login's self-check accepted at Demo Laboratory with the seeded setting, refused LAB_RESULT_SECOND_CHECK_REQUIRED at Demo Hospital); the seal holds (members and seal triggers unchanged, a real account still refused SEALED_DEMO_MEMBERSHIP_REFUSED at Demo Laboratory, a real administrator refused FACILITY_SETTING_PERMISSION_DENIED there, the demo login may switch it off as any administrator). Mutants killed: the demo row written off, the demo id check dropped, the demo audit row dropped, the once rule dropped (lab-one-person-demo); the governance FOR SHARE dropped (lab-one-person-check's catalog check and the race checks); the install's revoke from PUBLIC dropped (0111's post-check, which reads a NULL function ACL as the default one, stopped with 55000); the self-check reason trimmed with one-argument btrim (lab-one-person-check). Two-session concurrency, now committed as services/ehr-api/scripts/lab-one-person-race-checks.mjs and passed on copies of both databases: an open self-check blocks a switch-off (55P03 under lock_timeout), a stale SERIALIZABLE self-check fails 40001 and its retry answers LAB_RESULT_SECOND_CHECK_REQUIRED, a READ COMMITTED self-check waiting on a switch-off answers LAB_RESULT_SECOND_CHECK_REQUIRED. lab-api: tsc clean, jest 494 of 494; identity-api: tsc clean, jest 1881 of 1881 (one timing-bound case in patient-contact-change passed on its own re-run).
